verdict.rationale: Pinecone documents semantic similarity search over embeddings: a single index serves semantic and sparse-vector search, and results can be ranked by `dense_vector` or `sparse_vector`. A community comment corroborates that it offered HNSW-based approximate nearest-neighbor search. However, nothing in the pack shows that the distance metric can be configured. Missing for 10: documented configurable distance metrics (e.g. cosine/euclidean/dot product), explicit first-party ANN algorithm documentation, hands-on corroboration of query quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run approximate nearest-neighbor similarity search over embeddings with configurable distance metrics

citations.quote: A single index can serve full-text search (BM25 with Lucene queries), semantic search, and sparse-vector search together
When you search, you rank results via `score_by`: `text` (BM25), `query_string` (Lucene), `dense_vector`, or `sparse_vector`.
There was a long time that pgvector only had basic similarity algorithms and not HNSW but pinecone did.
